gates: edition only level 2 - correct edition not secured

edition.check: Level 5: INPUT contains a barcode (NOT MET: input has only title, artist, format; input_has_barcode is false). Level 4: Barcode match in one source, or without barcode title, artist, format plus >= 1 further attribute unambiguous in >= 2 sources AND no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist (NOT MET: input provides no further attribute such as label, catno, year, or country, and competing vinyl releases fitting the input have different tracklists, e.g. musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f with 22 tracks). Level 3: Unambiguous in one source with no competing edition, or several editions fit but ALL share the same tracklist (NOT MET: tool call 2 shows musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f with exact title 'Random Access Memories', artist 'Daft Punk', format 'Vinyl+Vinyl+Vinyl' and 22 tracks, as well as box set musicbrainz:release/fc1eb6d6-1c46-429a-8332-4f881c541ae7 with 34 tracks). Level 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one of them has a DIFFERENT tracklist; the choice rests on weak signals (MET: both the 13-track 2xLP editions and the 22-track 3xLP 2023 edition musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f match title, artist, and format Vinyl, and the input lacks barcode, year, or catno to rule out the 22-track edition).
edition.summary: Without barcode, year, or catalogue number in the input, competing vinyl editions with different tracklists (such as the 22-track 3xLP edition) fit the input and cannot be ruled out.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles with spelling variants only (MET: musicbrainz:release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655 in tool call 5 and discogs:release/4570366 in tool call 6 both represent the 2013 2xLP Columbia 88883716861 release with barcode 888837168618 and agree on all 13 tracks, positions A1 to D4, and titles up to capitalization/apostrophe style, with durations matching within 0-2 seconds).
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz and Discogs entries for the 2013 2xLP edition agree completely on track count (13), vinyl positions (A1-D4), and track titles.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: Database + independent primary source such as read cover/booklet/label print or label/manufacturer info (NOT MET: only database APIs were queried in tool calls 1-6; no cover images or primary sources were read). Level 4: Two independent database entries recognisable by differing details, or database + specialised collector site (MET: musicbrainz:release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655 and discogs:release/4570366 are independent database entries with distinct details, including ISRCs and 1-2s shorter durations on A1, A2, C2, D4 in MusicBrainz versus etched runout matrices, label code LC00162, and title-case formatting in Discogs).
sources.summary: The result is backed by two independent database entries (MusicBrainz and Discogs) showing distinct metadata details, without an inspected primary source.

concerns: Unsupported claim in alternatives: 'discogs:release/28924120' ('2023 Drumless Edition, 2xLP') never appears in any tool output (tool call 1 was truncated before any such ID and it was never queried).

Unsupported tracklist claims in alternatives: the agent claims 'identische Trackliste' for discogs:release/9216088 and discogs:release/31621720 (and 2021/2022 reissues) without ever fetching their release tracklists.

Ambiguity handling: despite competing Vinyl editions with different track counts fitting the input (e.g. 22-track musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f), status was set to 'found' instead of 'ambiguous'.
